module_summary: Round-robin arbiter: double-width subtract trick picks the first requester at or after a one-hot priority pointer; grant locks until accepted, then pointer rotates.

anchors.name: prio_q
anchors.why: One-hot round-robin pointer; rotated past the granted requester on accept.

anchors.name: gnt_q
anchors.why: Registered one-hot grant vector held while locked, drives gnt_o.

anchors.name: locked_q
anchors.why: Grant-held flag; freezes grant until accept_i, triggers pointer rotation, drives gnt_valid_o.

anchors.name: dbl_gnt
anchors.why: Double-width priority-select result folded into the next grant vector.

anchors.name: req_i
anchors.why: Per-requester request vector arbitrated and starting a lock.

anchors.name: gnt_o
anchors.why: One-hot grant to requesters from gnt_q.

anchors.name: accept_i
anchors.why: Acknowledges the grant; releases lock, clears grant, rotates priority.

groups.name: rr_select
groups.description: Priority pointer and masked select logic computing the one-hot grant.

groups.name: grant_lock
groups.description: Holds grant until accepted, then releases and rotates priority.
